olivia: FYI RC 0.18.0 stuck. regen produced a typegen diff and sample-kit onboarding CI failed. Anyone free to triage?
sam: paste CI link
olivia: https://ci.internal/17666 job 9
olivia: snippet:
```
Error: type-hash mismatch
- export interface CreateWidget { title: string; meta?: Record<string, any>; tags?: string[] }
+ export interface CreateWidget { meta?: Record<string, any>; title: string; tags?: string[] }
```
sam: Ugh property order again. Root cause: generator updated and now emits properties in (seemingly) insertion-order. Two options: 1) enable deterministic property sort in typegen config, 2) pin the previous generator version.
olivia: Semver guard also blocked publish earlier; changelog entry is currently labeled "minor". This fix should be a patch (SDK parity).
ci-bot: publish-gate: blocked due to metadata/typehash mismatch. See report.
sam: Plan: change tools/typegen/config.json -> "stablePropertySort": true, regen, run `yarn sample-kit:test`, update package.json type-hash, and update CHANGELOG.md line to "patch: SDK regen parity fix". No spec edits.
release-ops: If CI still fails after PR, request release exception with note: "non-user-facing SDK parity regen".
olivia: please tag me on the PR for changelog wording. Also add a short before/after diff in the PR body.
sam: Will open PR in ~15m and run local smoke tests first.
ci-bot: build queued for sam/regen-stableSort.
olivia: thanks — let's try to avoid manual release exceptions. :crossed_fingers:
